title: Restriction to free coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^{\mathrm{Fin}(n)}\to\alpha$ be a function. For each assignment $z$ of signs outside $J$, the restriction of $f$ at $z$ is the function on sign assignments $y$ in $J$ obtained by evaluating $f$ on the assignment that agrees with $y$ on $J$ and with $z$ outside $J$.
